title: Unique Creamy Venezuelan Plantain Bowl
description: A funky and romantic Venezuelan dish featuring light rum and ferment, this vegan-friendly plantain bowl is served in an earthenware bowl. It combines the sweetness of plantains with the creaminess of a cashew-based sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel the plantains and slice them into 1-inch rounds.
Place the plantain slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the plantains are baking, blend the soaked cashews with 1/2 cup of water until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the light rum, ferment, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the blended cashew mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Once the plantains are done baking, add them to the skillet and stir to combine with the cashew sauce.
Transfer the plantain mixture to an earthenware bowl and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve the unique creamy Venezuelan plantain bowl hot.
